items.source: EndpointAccessResolver that resolves the permitted level of access to an endpoint using the following properties: management.endpoint.<id>.access or management.endpoint.<id>.enabled (deprecated) management.endpoints.access.default or management.endpoints.enabled-by-default (deprecated) The resulting access is capped using management.endpoints.access.max-permitted.
items.translation: EndpointAccessResolver 用于解析对端点的允许访问级别，使用以下属性： management.endpoint.<id>.access 或 management.endpoint.<id>.enabled（已弃用） management.endpoints.access.default 或 management.endpoints.enabled-by-default（已弃用） 生成的访问权限受 management.endpoints.access.max-permitted 限制。
